notes: ViperTab Zen edition launch — minimalist new tab. Big centered digital clock taking the whole screen, auto-hiding menu bar (slides in on hover near top) and dock (slides in near bottom), no widget chrome, just glass and air. Default theme: Zen Dark (black bg / white text / gold accent); also Zen Light (cream / black / gold). Accent color is fully customizable via Control Center color picker. One optional secondary widget below the clock — defaults to weather, swappable to anything from Control Center.
